messages:
jon: Quick heads-up — ran the link-checker and hit a 404 in docs/runtime/kv-cache.md. The 'prefetch' anchor points to /runtime#prefetch which 404s in prod. Anyone own that page?

mia: thanks for the ping. that's in the runtime guide cluster — iirc @alex has been maintaining it. alex, any idea?

alex: I can take a look. can you paste the failing URL and the link-checker output?

jon: here — https://docs.redwood.com/runtime/kv-cache.md#prefetch returns 404. also saw the curl example referencing `--data @sample.json` but that file isn't in the repo anymore. link-checker output: `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md: line 120: https://docs.redwood.com/runtime/kv-cache.md#prefetch -> 404`

alex: ok, i'll open a tiny PR to update the anchor and change the example to an inline sample. pinging for a quick CR @mia @sam

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — sed to fix anchor + update example

mia: i'll review shortly. can you add a one-line deprecation note for the `prefetch` param (so we don't silently drop it)? reviewers should check the phrasing is clear + non-actionable for users.

sam: LGTM on the anchor fix, but re: the removed sample file — other runtime examples reference it. i'd prefer we inline the minimal JSON snippet so examples stay runnable, e.g.: ```json
{"prompt":"hello"}
```

alex: good call, i'll inline the snippet and add a changelog bullet and the deprecation note. updating PR now.

devex-bot: link-checker: staging run detected 1 remaining broken link in /handbook/ — tagging docs-team :robot_face:

mia: thanks bot. i'll follow up on the handbook after the runtime PR lands. @docs-team if anyone sees staging failures please drop them here.

jon: cool — if there are no objections i'll merge once CI is green and alex adds the inline snippet + deprecation line.

alex: CI is green, PR updated with inline snippet and short deprecation note in the examples section. i'll merge in ~15m if no objections :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

mia: thank you! also can we add alex as an owner in the frontmatter for runtime so future link rot pings route to the right person?

alex: will do — added myself in the PR frontmatter.

jon: wrapping up — re-ran link-checker locally against staging after the merge and all clear. thanks for the quick turnaround, team!
